post.description: Processes stateless MCP requests. Request and response bodies are opaque JSON objects because their exact JSON-RPC shape depends on the MCP method.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: MCP protocol version; required and matched against request metadata for modern requests

parameters.name: Mcp-Method
parameters.description: MCP method; required and matched against the JSON-RPC body for modern requests

parameters.name: Mcp-Name
parameters.description: MCP tool name; required and matched for modern tools/call requests

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Request origin, when sent, must be allow-listed

requestBody.description: Opaque MCP JSON-RPC request object; fields depend on the requested method

400.description: Invalid MCP metadata, protocol version, or malformed JSON body

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired read API key

403.description: Request origin is not allowed

413.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit

500.description: MCP authentication or request processing failed

FeedbackFinding.description:
Schema-only view of legacy JSONB findings. Known fields are optional and
additional properties remain allowed because stored output is passed through.

FeedbackWorkaround.description:
Schema-only view of legacy JSONB workarounds. Known fields are optional and
additional properties remain allowed because stored output is passed through.

OpaqueJsonObject.description: Opaque JSON object whose fields depend on the MCP JSON-RPC method.
